items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: They quit calling him Babin, they called him Tubby, they used to call him Big Tubby, and they used to call me Little Tubby.

ctx.x: Around 95, because I was two years older than him. I don't want to interrupt so much, but while we were talking about Tubby, what was his real name and how did he get that name? His right name was Fred Hall. Oh that's right, Fred.

Fred Hall, yeah. Now where he got this Tubby from, he got so fat. Oh yeah, he was fat when I was born. They quit calling him Babin, they called him Tubby, they used to call him Big Tubby, and they used to call me Little Tubby.
Little Tubby, I never heard that.
